resources.name: QuantLib
resources.rationale: C++ instrument/pricer framework: bonds, CDS, inflation products, OIS, swaps, swaptions and FX forwards.
resources.notes: BSD-style terms are in LICENSE.TXT; API SPDX detection is NOASSERTION. Readme badge names BSD-3-Clause. Not executed.

resources.name: QuantLib language bindings
resources.rationale: Official QuantLib SWIG bindings for Python, C#, Java, Scala and R; same analytics family as QuantLib.
resources.notes: Bindings, not an independent pricing engine. Match the binding and native QuantLib versions.

resources.name: Open Source Risk Engine
resources.rationale: QuantLib-based pricing, simulation, risk analytics and XVA with trade/market/configuration interfaces and examples.
resources.license: BSD-3-Clause-style / Modified BSD (README; GitHub SPDX NOASSERTION)
resources.notes: Source documents validation/training uses; no local model validation or market calibration performed.

resources.name: ORE language bindings
resources.rationale: Bindings for QuantExt, OREData and OREAnalytics; permits Python and other languages to access the ORE family.
resources.notes: Separate wrapper repo; build documentation depends on a compatible ORE release. Last push 2024; current compatibility untested.

resources.name: Strata
resources.rationale: Java market analytics and risk library; product source includes bonds, credit, deposits, FRA, FX/FX options, swaps, swaptions and cap/floor modules.
resources.notes: Canonical repo transferred from OpenGamma/Strata, same GitHub repository ID 20882897. README retains historical OpenGamma links.

resources.name: finmath lib
resources.rationale: Java multi-curve valuation/calibration, OIS and cross-currency products, bonds, CDS, SABR, Hull-White and forward-rate Monte Carlo.
resources.notes: Default branch is main (renamed 2025-10-12). No numeric benchmarks reproduced.

resources.name: finmath experiments
resources.rationale: Examples and experiments using finmath; useful for curve calibration and interest-rate-model learning rather than independent vendor analytics.
resources.notes: Companion of finmath-lib; not counted as an independent numerical engine.

resources.name: FinancePy
resources.rationale: Inspectable Python/Numba implementations for fixed-income, FX and credit derivative pricing and risk management.
resources.notes: GPL obligations and financial conventions need review before integration; no calculation verification claimed.

resources.name: GS Quant
resources.rationale: Python toolkit for derivatives, risk, structuring and cross-asset analytics; useful for studying FICC workflows and instrument interfaces.
resources.notes: Source code is open; README says API access requires institutional client ID/secret. Do not imply data/API access is free or bundled.

resources.name: TF Quant Finance
resources.rationale: TensorFlow numerical finance reference with rate-curve construction, Hull-White, SABR and calibration examples.
resources.notes: README explicitly says ARCHIVED/no longer maintained, even though GitHub archived flag was false at observation. Use as legacy research/reference.

resources.name: bond_pricing
resources.rationale: Python bond price/YTM, accrued interest, duration and zero-curve construction, plus NPV/IRR and compounding conversions.
resources.notes: Small, targeted bond calculations; optional SciPy fallback changes numerical algorithms and must be accounted for in replication.

resources.name: Nelson-Siegel-Svensson
resources.rationale: Python Nelson-Siegel and Nelson-Siegel-Svensson zero/forward curves and OLS/nonlinear calibration.
resources.notes: Last push 2023. Narrow reference implementation; no current Python-version or optimizer regression tests were run.

resources.name: yieldcurves
resources.rationale: Python yield curves, interpolation, compounding, discount factors and FX-related curve methods.
resources.notes: Last push 2024. Verify curve/date conventions and current dependencies before adapter work.

resources.name: dcf
resources.rationale: Python discounted-cashflow and payment-leg construction for loans and banking instruments.
resources.notes: Cashflow toolkit, not market data. Last push 2025; no current build run.

resources.name: businessdate
resources.rationale: Python business dates, holiday adjustments, day-count year fractions and payment schedule generation.
resources.notes: Infrastructure for loan/derivative schedules. Calendar coverage and day-count edge cases require case-specific testing.

resources.name: QuantLib.jl (original)
resources.rationale: Pure Julia alpha implementation with bonds, swaps, swaptions, partial CDS, short-rate models and yield/default curves.
resources.notes: README calls it alpha; original repo last push 2020. JuliaQuant/QuantLib.jl is a fork, omitted as duplicate. Not official C++ QuantLib bindings.

resources.name: FinancialToolbox.jl
resources.rationale: Julia Black/Black-Scholes pricing, Greeks, implied volatility and day-count functions, including generic numeric/AD types.
resources.notes: General options numerics relevant to FICC derivatives; not a full fixed-income curve/contract system.

resources.name: PyFENG
resources.rationale: Academic Python reference models including Bachelier, SABR, stochastic volatility, Greeks and implied volatility.
resources.notes: Canonical repo transferred from PyFE/pyfeng, same ID 342517882. README explicitly targets academic use; no production readiness claim.

resources.name: isda_daycounters
resources.rationale: Minimal Python day-count collection covering Actual/360, Actual/365, Actual/Actual and several 30/360 variants.
resources.license: UNKNOWN / no license file found in root
resources.notes: Last push 2020. Treat as a public code reference pending license clarification; not approved for reuse/distribution.

resources.name: Rateslib
resources.rationale: Fixed-income analysis for bonds/futures, IRS, cross-currency and FX swaps, curve solving and AD risk sensitivities.
resources.notes: README explicitly states NOT open source. Commercial use requires a paid license. Keep outside the OSI-open-source subset.

resources.name: OpenBB Open Data Platform
resources.rationale: 固定收益、外汇、商品和经济数据扩展；适合构建 FICC 研究的数据接入层。
resources.notes: Canonical repository ID 323048702; historical OpenBB-finance/OpenBB redirects here. LICENSE explicitly declares Apache-2.0 although GitHub SPDX detection says NOASSERTION. Individual providers retain their own credentials, subscriptions and data rights.

resources.name: AKShare
resources.rationale: 公开财经接口覆盖债券、期货、外汇与宏观数据，可作为中国 FICC 数据发现入口。
resources.notes: Code license does not grant redistribution rights to upstream data; availability and source schemas were not tested.

resources.name: TuShare / TuShare Pro SDK
resources.rationale: 官方 Pro 文档提供期货合约、日线、主连续映射以及外汇/债券接口；可研究交割、持仓和连续合约数据。
resources.maturity: SDK + separate data service / source reviewed
resources.notes: Use official service documentation for coverage, not the stock-focused legacy README. Token, points and endpoint permissions apply; no authenticated request made. Low code push frequency does not imply the data service stopped updating.

resources.name: VeighNa / vn.py
resources.rationale: 国内外期货、期权接口和 CTA/组合研究框架，提供合约、行情、回测和执行工程参考。
resources.notes: Gateways and data vendors may have separate dependencies, licenses, accounts and permissions. Listing is not live-trading validation.

resources.name: NautilusTrader
resources.rationale: Rust/Python 事件驱动研究与执行框架；README 明确包含 FX、期货、期权以及订单簿回放。
resources.notes: Adapter-specific asset coverage, account/data rights and exact release behavior require independent tests.

resources.name: pysystemtrade
resources.rationale: 系统化期货交易研究、组合配置、合约数据和 Interactive Brokers 工作流参考。
resources.notes: Historical robcarver17/pysystemtrade moved to pst-group in January 2026 per README; repository ID 46975254 preserved. No strategy performance claim or broker session validated.

resources.name: QuantConnect LEAN
resources.rationale: 多资产事件驱动引擎，官方样例包括外汇和期货链/到期筛选，可学习跨资产回测契约。
resources.notes: Also checked BasicTemplateForexAlgorithm.py. Data purchases, broker connections, cloud services and derivative data rights are separate.

resources.name: finmarketpy
resources.rationale: FX spot/forward/option 总回报、波动率曲面、事件研究与黄金/外汇季节性示例。
resources.notes: Examples can depend on findatapy/FinancePy and licensed vendor inputs; tutorials and historical charts do not prove profitability.

resources.name: findatapy
resources.rationale: 面向 FX 的多来源数据封装，README 展示 AUDJPY、bid/ask tick、FRED/ALFRED 以及订阅数据接口。
resources.notes: Bloomberg/Eikon and other providers require separate licenses; public downloads retain source-specific conditions.

resources.name: tcapy
resources.rationale: FX spot 成交成本分析，包含订单/成交、基准价、滑点和合成交叉汇率参考。
resources.notes: README currently scopes supported order/trade data to FX spot; do not generalize to all asset classes. Last repository push observed in 2024.

resources.name: QSForex
resources.rationale: QuantStart 外汇交易日记配套的 alpha 阶段事件驱动/点差回测项目，适合学习和讨论原型。
resources.license: MIT (declared in README; GitHub license field absent)
resources.notes: README explicitly calls it alpha; last push observed in 2022. Historical OANDA integration may need substantial updating; standalone license detection missing. Do not treat as a production recommendation.

resources.name: backtrader
resources.rationale: 通用事件驱动回测框架包含 futures-like 保证金现金调整、佣金/滑点和历史 OANDA 接口。
resources.notes: Many integrations and examples are historical; package compatibility and fill models require retesting.

resources.name: forex-python
resources.rationale: 简单汇率与币种换算 API，适合作为入门/小型 FX 数据处理示例。
resources.notes: Daily reference-rate utility, not tick/executable quotes; external rates service was not contacted. README endpoint naming is historical.

resources.name: oandapyV20
resources.rationale: 第三方 OANDA REST v20 Python wrapper，便于研究 FX 行情/账户/订单 API 结构。
resources.notes: README identifies a personal project, not an official OANDA SDK. Credentials, regional availability and service terms apply; no order sent and no API session tested.

resources.name: fredapi
resources.rationale: FRED/ALFRED Python 接口及 vintage/as-of 查询，可支持利率/宏观研究和数据修订控制。
resources.notes: FRED key is required; series-specific rights and release timestamps remain separate. Vintage support alone does not prove a backtest is free from look-ahead.

resources.name: sdmx1
resources.rationale: SDMX 2.1/3.0 数据与元数据客户端，支持央行、国际组织和统计机构数据源。
resources.notes: Fork lineage to pandaSDMX is documented. Endpoint availability and code mappings are provider-specific and untested.

resources.name: pandaSDMX
resources.rationale: SDMX 数据/元数据工具，README 列出 BIS、ECB、OECD 等 FICC 相关宏观提供方。
resources.notes: Last repository push observed in 2023; sdmx1 is a related fork, not a renamed identical project. No live endpoint check.

resources.name: pandas-datareader
resources.rationale: pandas 宏观/政策数据访问，README 展示 FRED GS10 并列出 Bank of Canada、World Bank、OECD 等。
resources.notes: GitHub API returns NOASSERTION; LICENSE.md contains the 3-clause BSD text. Source-specific availability and licenses apply.

resources.name: gridstatus
resources.rationale: 北美电力 ISO/RTO 与 EIA 的负荷、燃料结构、LMP、辅助服务等，为能源商品基本面提供入口。
resources.notes: Open-source direct-source client differs from paid hosted API. Some sources require credentials; ISO-local time, DST, retention and data terms need explicit handling.

resources.name: PyPSA
resources.rationale: 电力/能源系统调度、储能和部门耦合优化，可作为电力商品基本面研究的邻接工具。
resources.notes: Not a derivatives pricer or trading system. Perfect-foresight optimization examples must not be interpreted as realistic historical trading tests; solver licenses are separate.

resources.name: oemof.solph
resources.rationale: 能源系统 LP/MILP 优化模型生成器，适合研究供需、储能和能源转换约束。
resources.notes: Repository license API field absent; README SPDX says MIT. It is an adjacent fundamentals model, not an exchange-price forecaster or derivative trading framework. Solvers require separate installation/terms.

resources.name: Databento Python
resources.rationale: 官方历史/实时市场数据客户端，包含期货换月 smart symbology 与多种市场数据 schema。
resources.notes: SDK source is open; data plans, exchange entitlements, credentials and redistribution restrictions are separate. No paid or authenticated download executed.

resources.name: Databento Binary Encoding (DBN)
resources.rationale: 市场数据消息编码、存储和 CLI/Python/Rust 工具，可用于期货逐笔/订单簿管道设计。
resources.notes: A message format/tool, not a free data source. Source and dataset licenses are independent.

resources.name: yfinance
resources.rationale: 第三方 Yahoo 数据工具的 market 模块明确提供 RATES、COMMODITIES、CURRENCIES 分类，可用于探索性数据发现。
resources.notes: README states Yahoo Finance API data is intended for personal use only. Do not assume commercial use, redistributable data, tick accuracy or institutional coverage.

resources.name: Rates Bond Quant
resources.rationale: 维护者自己的教学项目：简化债券现金流、价格、久期、凸性、利率冲击与多期限比较，附 Python/FastAPI/Next.js 界面。
resources.notes: Maintainer-owned project, disclosed. Earlier ficc-rates-bond-quant URL redirects here. Educational reconstruction; no production or live trading claim, and this catalog update did not rerun its tests.
